category_title: Marginalized urban students with histories of truancy and classroom disengagement
scenario_title: Initial reluctance and disengagement from mandatory class activities
minimal_context: The student is joining a semicircle group to choose a role for a mandatory moot court reenactment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are starting our court case reenactment today. Please pull your chairs into a semicircle and choose if you want to be the petitioner, respondent, or judge.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm just trying to get in and get out of here. I'm only doing what I need to do to graduate.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The moot court format requires all students to participate. Which role would you like?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: In my previous social studies classes, they ain't teach me nothing. Like they just hand out the textbook and read up to this chapter or whatever. I don't feel like this is for me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are doing the court case today, not reading the textbook. Please join your teammates.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Look Peter, I know it's an assigned kind of thing, but people get so over that too. I'm not participating in this, I just want to sit here.

task.learning_goal: defend your point of view and speak in public

context.environment: students rarely sat in rows; rather, they worked in circles or semicircles

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: being required to participate in all activities
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: arrived unwilling to participate in class activities, expressed displeasure in being required to participate
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: disengaged, trying to 'get in and get out', doing only what they needed to do to graduate
related_quotes: people get so over that too.

behavior_patterns.condition: At the beginning of the course or when faced with traditional social studies instruction
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: unwilling to participate, disengaged, doing only what is needed to graduate
behavior_patterns.internal_state: negative experiences in school, don't feel like school's a place for them
related_quotes: In my previous social studies classes, they ain’t teach me nothing.
